Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 299)

Changes since build 293.

Build 299: No more session text in new terminals

  • A new terminal no longer shows a short "session created" line before the prompt.

Build 298: New terminals open without a flash

  • A new terminal shows its own background at once and starts in the same moment, instead of showing the window background first.
  • The "Last login" line is no longer printed when a terminal starts.
  • New persistent terminals skip one background check, so they start a little sooner.

Build 297: Split panes stop blinking

  • Adding a split pane (Cmd-D) or closing one no longer makes the other panes blink.

Build 296: Instant terminal, automatic Picture in Picture

  • Cmd-T and Cmd-D open a terminal at once. A fast second press swaps it for a browser in the same place.
  • Videos playing with sound move into Picture in Picture when you leave the tab and come back when you return. A Settings switch (Browser) turns it off.

Build 295: Browser stays visible after Cmd-D

  • The browser page no longer goes blank after Cmd-D splits a browser tab.

Build 294: Pointer comes back after video

  • The mouse pointer comes back after a video or web page hides it, when you leave the page, switch tabs or split.
  • "Hide pointer while typing" now only hides the pointer over the terminal you type in.

Known issue: the pointer can still stay hidden over a video in some cases. Diagnostics were added to find it.
